algorithms.label: SA-SETS
algorithms.name: sa_sets
algorithms.parameter_basis: Project 2023 thesis: 8 searchers, 4 regions, 2 goods per region; mu is retained from the existing SA-SETS implementation. SensorEncodingV3 uses V2 coverage selection and redundancy removal, but a routing-rejected sensor remains scheduled with next_hop=-1 and the chromosome is not modified.

algorithms.label: SI-SETSv2 (Elitist Role-separated Update)
algorithms.name: si_setsv2
algorithms.parameter_basis: RL-SETSv4 market-update ablation without reinforcement learning. Every searcher-good pair produces two crossover children and mutates each with probability mu. Searchers accept only their best improving child1; every visited good accepts the best visiting child2 only when it improves the old good.
